Gather at the Gulf

7 Bedrooms 7 Full Bathrooms 3 Half Bathrooms 16 Sleeps Inlet Beach
  • Description
  • Amenities
  • Reviews
  • Calendar
  • Location

Home Highlights
- Gulf Views
- Private Pool (Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day)
- 6-Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included
- Elevator
- Short Walk to the Beach
- Spacious Outdoor Space

Located just one home back from the Gulf, the property offers sweeping water views from every level and effortless access to the beach. A short stroll leads to open, unrestricted shoreline, an uncommon and highly sought-after feature in Walton County.

Designed with both comfort and entertaining in mind, the home features two expansive decks ideal for taking in Gulf breezes and unforgettable sunsets. Below, the generous backyard provides ample space for outdoor activities, gatherings, and relaxed coastal living, complemented by a private, shaded pool that serves as a tranquil retreat.
Inside, an open and airy floor plan showcases European white oak flooring, crown molding, and custom luxury tile throughout. The chef-inspired kitchen is outfitted with premium Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, offering both beauty and performance. Seven spacious bedrooms, each with its own en suite bath, allow the home to comfortably host large families or groups while maintaining privacy for all. An elevator services every level for ease and accessibility, and a professionally installed alarm system adds an extra layer of security and peace of mind.

Perfectly positioned just one mile from Rosemary Beach and 30Avenue, this home places renowned dining, boutique shopping, and local entertainment within easy reach, whether by foot, bike, or car.

July 25, 2026 - Website

Great Property

by Britt Cotter
Gather on the Gulf was a great property for our 8 adults and 5 kids (ages 9-14). We were there during TS Bertha, and the house was very secure. With all the space in the house, we never felt crowded. The house was clean. Great week for our family!
June 9, 2026 - Website

Recommend to all

by Kellie
This house was clean and very well appointed and extremely roomy for our large family. The extra living areas for the children to enjoy themselves while giving the adults some space to relax was a plus. The very short walk to the beach was convenient with little ones and we actually had view of the beach and gulf from the balcony. We appreciated the close proximity to 30A/ Hwy 98 so there was no sitting in traffic. I would highly recommend this house
